cases.contribution: The actual result Future connects the cache eviction to the request left waiting. Two recorded dispatch Handles recover the distinct original callers that triggered the eviction and awaited the result.
cases.contribution_zh: 用实际结果 Future 对上缓存淘汰和仍在等待的请求，再沿各自记录的调度 Handle，分别找回触发淘汰和等待结果的原始调用者。

cases.title: Which caller accounts for the repeated await-chain rethrows?
cases.title_zh: 多层 await 的重复重抛分别来自哪个调用者？

findings.observation: Two faulted chains interleave on one worker. Stock EventPipe records 16 exceptions with identical type and message, including 14 rethrows with identical stacks. The final Exception.StackTrace shows propagation through Chain. The EventPipe exception records and final stacks omit both synchronous launchers. Successful chains produce zero exceptions. Forwarding directly to the same leaves produces only the two initial throws.
findings.interpretation: FirstChanceException provides the exact Exception object for each first throw and rethrow. The completed root Task holds that same object as its fault, so CoroPerf can join every throw stack back to the initial Task record. In the displayed run, LaunchInventory contributes two rethrows (representative edge 1 → 4) and LaunchProfile contributes twelve (0 → 5). Reversing the launch or release order leaves object matching intact. Swapping the depths moves the rethrow count to the other caller.
findings.limits: The stitched replay covers faulted Tasks on Linux CoreCLR 8.0.34 and 10.0.0. A separate application control replaces twelve transparent await-only layers with direct Task forwarding. Both versions retain the result, original fault object, and cancellation token. Forwarding removes the twelve relay throws for both fault and cancellation in this fixture and returns the leaf Task itself. The runtime issue remains open.

findings_zh.observation: 两条失败的调用链在同一工作线程上交错执行。原生 EventPipe 记录了 16 次抛出，异常类型与消息相同，其中 14 次重抛的调用栈相同。最终的 Exception.StackTrace 能看到经过 Chain 的传播路径，但原生事件和异常栈都缺少同步发起者。成功对照有 0 次抛出，直接转发到同样的叶子 Task 时只有 2 次首次抛出。
findings_zh.interpretation: FirstChanceException 在首次抛出和重抛时都提供实际的异常对象。已完成的根 Task 保存了同一个异常对象，CoroPerf 由此把每条抛出栈拼回最初记录的 Task 创建栈。展示运行中，LaunchInventory 有 2 次重抛，代表性拼接为 1 → 4。LaunchProfile 有 12 次重抛，代表性拼接为 0 → 5。交换发起或放行顺序仍可匹配，交换 await 深度后，重抛次数随调用链一起改变归属。
findings_zh.limits: 拼接实验覆盖 Linux CoreCLR 8.0.34 和 10.0.0 上的失败 Task。独立的应用侧对照将 12 层只做 await 的转发改为直接返回 Task。两种运行时都保留成功结果、原始异常对象和取消令牌。该对照中，失败与取消时都消除了 12 次转发重抛，且直接返回叶子 Task。运行时 Issue 仍开放。

cases.contribution: Two fault chains interleave on one worker with identical rethrow stacks. The actual exception object in each root Task connects the rethrows to its original caller.
cases.contribution_zh: 两条失败链在同一个工作线程交错执行，重抛栈相同。用根 Task 实际保存的异常对象，可以把重抛接回各自的原始调用者。

cases.title: Which callers launched the continuations delayed by Bun's nested poll?
cases.title_zh: Bun 嵌套轮询拖延的两个协程由谁发起？

findings.observation: In the displayed Bun 1.4.3 run, both immediates resolve their promises before a 165 ms epoll_pwait2 call that returns zero events. Both await continuations resume after the same poll. Their ordinary stacks are identical. The stock Inspector follows the async parent to setImmediate and the shared dispatch, and both original launchers are absent.
findings.interpretation: CoroPerf records the actual Promise object when each hop is created. The continuation looks up the object it awaited in the same WeakMap. Its creation stack restores launchInventory (1 → 2) and launchProfile (0 → 3) even though the second launch resumes first. The resolve and resume checkpoints in the syscall trace associate both stitched stacks with one poll. Withholding Promise identity leaves both samples unassigned.
findings.limits: This Linux x86-64 replay uses two immediate promises and a loopback listener. The replay sets the GC timer interval to 180 ms. Both 1.4.3 and 1.4.5 show the stall. Direct await and canary dac8e3b0f show prompt continuation. The probe records Promise objects at application checkpoints. Two batches verify 48 joins, including the canary comparison and both launch and dispatch orders.

findings_zh.observation: 在展示的 Bun 1.4.3 运行中，两个 immediate 都已兑现各自的 Promise，随后同一次 epoll_pwait2 等了约 165 毫秒，返回 0 个事件。两个 await 都在这次轮询返回后才恢复。普通栈完全相同。原生 Inspector 能沿异步父栈追到 setImmediate 和共享调度位置，两条栈均缺少原始发起者。
findings_zh.interpretation: CoroPerf 在每一跳创建时登记实际 Promise 对象。恢复后，用刚才 await 的同一个对象查询 WeakMap，接回对应的创建栈。即使后发起的调用先恢复，记录 1 → 2 仍指向 launchInventory，0 → 3 仍指向 launchProfile。系统调用追踪中的兑现与恢复时间点把两条拼接栈都关联到同一次轮询。移除 Promise 身份后，两条采样均无法归属。
findings_zh.limits: 复现在 Linux x86-64 上运行，使用两个 immediate Promise 和一个本地回环监听 socket。实验将 GC 定时器间隔设为 180 毫秒。1.4.3 和 1.4.5 都出现长等，直接 await 和 canary dac8e3b0f 都很快恢复。探针在应用代码的观测点记录 Promise 对象。两批实验共核对 48 条拼接，覆盖 canary 对照，并分别交换发起和派发顺序。

cases.contribution: Two ready continuations share one long poll. Matching their Promise objects to their creation stacks recovers the two callers even when the second launch resumes first.
cases.contribution_zh: 两个已就绪的协程被同一次长轮询拖延。按实际 Promise 对象拼回创建栈，即使后发起的协程先恢复，也能找出各自的调用者。

cases.title: Who triggered each replacement dial on the shared SQL opener?
cases.title_zh: 同一个 SQL 连接协程执行的补拨，分别由谁触发？

findings.observation: The pool reports three open connections while the driver has zero live connections, and a fourth waiter times out. The first replacement dial is held while two subsequent opening signals enter the buffer. Go's goroutine profile with ancestor stacks and the dial stacks identify the same opener created by OpenDB. The execution trace records a direct wake for the initial signal. The later buffered signals leave no opener transition identifying either caller.
findings.interpretation: The probe records completed sends and receives on the same opener channel. The pool mutex serializes the sends, and one goroutine receives them in FIFO order. A dial stack with no request ID falls between the receive and finish of one opening interval. The displayed joins connect that interval back to discardProfile (records 0 → 3) or discardInventory (1 → 6). Withholding the receive-to-finish intervals leaves both samples unassigned.
findings.limits: This is a bounded standard-library replay on Linux x86-64 using Go 1.20.6 and 1.26.8 and a gated in-memory driver. The fixture returns ErrBadConn through Conn.Raw and controls dial completion. The probe leaves the channel and its empty payload unchanged. Two independent batches verify 16 caller joins across both releases and both discard orders.

findings_zh.observation: 连接池统计显示已打开 3 个连接，驱动实际可用连接为 0，额外的第 4 个等待者在等待中超时。第一次拨号被暂停时，后续两次补拨信号进入缓冲队列。开启祖先栈的 goroutine profile 和拨号栈都显示由 OpenDB 创建的同一个连接协程。执行追踪能看到第一条信号直接唤醒该协程。后续两条缓冲信号没有留下能指向各自调用者的协程状态变化。
findings_zh.interpretation: 探针记录同一个 opener 通道上已完成的发送和接收。连接池互斥锁串行化发送，唯一的接收协程按 FIFO 取出信号。不带请求 ID 的拨号栈落在一次接收至拨号完成的区间内，CoroPerf 据此匹配对应的发送栈。记录 0 → 3 接回 discardProfile，1 → 6 接回 discardInventory。去掉这些执行区间后，两条采样都失去归属。
findings_zh.limits: 在 Linux x86-64 的 Go 1.20.6 和 1.26.8 上，用可控制拨号完成的内存驱动复现标准库的连接池行为。实验通过 Conn.Raw 返回 ErrBadConn。探针沿用现有通道与空载荷。两批独立实验共核对 16 条调用者拼接，覆盖两个 Go 版本和两种连接丢弃顺序。

cases.contribution: Matching a buffered opener signal's FIFO position and the actual dial interval connects identical opener stacks to the two callers that invalidated connections.
cases.contribution_zh: 用补拨信号在同一通道中的 FIFO 顺序和实际拨号区间，将两条相同的拨号栈分别接回丢弃连接的调用者。

cases.title: Which feature launched the interceptor chain?
cases.title_zh: 哪个功能入口发起了这条拦截器链？

findings.observation: Two unawaited calls run the same Future.forEach interceptor chain. At CInterceptor.onRequest, both StackTrace.current and the VM Service stack views show identical locations for the two invocations on each tested SDK. On 3.5.3 the async chain ends within the Future loop. On 3.14.0 it reaches testFuture. Both feature launchers are absent on each version.
findings.interpretation: At binding, the probe records the actual nextIteration closure and its live stack. When the interceptor runs, it uses Dart identical to compare the active Future listener's callback with both previously observed closures. That exact object selects the creation stack. In the displayed run, featureB reaches the interceptor first and matches records 1 → 2. The second interceptor matches featureA at 0 → 3. Withholding the callback match leaves both stacks unassigned.
findings.limits: This Linux x86-64 JIT replay uses Dart SDK 3.5.3 and 3.14.0. It uses VM Service breakpoints and does not replace SDK callbacks. An independent check uses separate interceptor instance records. Two batches verify 32 joins with launch order and first-interceptor release order varied independently.

findings_zh.observation: 两个功能入口各自发起一个不等待结果的调用，执行同一条 Future.forEach 拦截器链。在 CInterceptor.onRequest 处，同一 SDK 上的两次 StackTrace.current 和 VM Service 栈视图均显示相同的代码位置。3.5.3 的异步栈停在 Future 循环，3.14.0 已能追到 testFuture。两个版本的栈都缺少原始功能入口。
findings_zh.interpretation: 绑定时，探针记录实际的 nextIteration 闭包和现场栈。执行拦截器时，用 Dart 的 identical 把当前 Future 监听器的回调与先前记录的两个闭包逐一比较，再拼接同一对象对应的创建栈。展示运行中，featureB 先到达拦截器，对应记录 1 → 2。第二次到达的 featureA 对应 0 → 3。移除回调匹配后，两条采样均无法归属。
findings_zh.limits: 这是 Linux x86-64 上使用 Dart SDK 3.5.3 和 3.14.0 的 JIT 复现。采集通过 VM Service 断点完成，SDK 回调保持原样。独立校验使用拦截器实例的单独记录。两批实验共验证 32 条拼接，分别交换发起顺序和第一个拦截器的放行顺序。

cases.contribution: The async stack reaches the shared interceptor chain. The identical Future listener callback connects each invocation to the distinct feature that launched it.
cases.contribution_zh: 异步栈只能追到共享的拦截器链。CoroPerf 用同一个 Future 监听器回调对象，将每次执行接回发起它的功能入口。

cases.title: Which caller incurred the extra coroutine-frame allocation?
cases.title_zh: 哪个调用者引发了额外的协程帧分配？

findings.observation: Clang 19 at -O2 generates an extra 48-byte heap allocation for Baz while Bar resumes in the await_resume variant. In the destructor control, the Baz header is initialized 24 bytes inside the Bar frame. The two requests cause six total allocation calls in the affected variant and four in the control. At the affected observation, symbolized GDB shows the same inline Baz, Bar and scheduler stack for both instances. Both original launchers are absent.
findings.interpretation: On the stripped ELF, the allocator's result in rax supplies the address for Baz's resume and destroy fields. Machine-code dataflow recovers the different active Bar frames from the resume argument preserved in rbx. The matching live creation records connect the two observations to launch_profile and launch_inventory. In the displayed run, the allocator returned the same Baz address twice. Withholding the Bar resume model or the construction history leaves both observations unattributed.
findings.limits: The replay schedules two instances of the archived C++20 reduction on one thread. Linux x86-64 Clang 19.1.7 builds omit frame pointers. Capture uses event-triggered register and stack snapshots on an ELF with no app symbols or CFI, using no function-bound sidecar or recorded resume intervals. Debug names are added after building the address graph. Two builds and replays verify 32 joins across both allocation layouts and independent launch and dispatch orders.

findings_zh.observation: 在 Clang 19 的 -O2 构建中，使用 await_resume 销毁子协程时，Bar 恢复期间会为 Baz 多做一次 48 字节的堆分配。析构函数对照把 Baz 的帧头初始化在 Bar 帧内偏移 24 字节的位置。执行两个请求时，两种写法分别调用分配函数 6 次和 4 次。在额外分配处，带符号的 GDB 对两个实例显示完全相同的内联 Baz、Bar 和调度栈，两者均缺少原始发起者。
findings_zh.interpretation: 在去符号的 ELF 上，分配函数把新分配的内存指针放入 rax，随后指令在该地址写入 Baz 的恢复和销毁指针。CoroPerf 按机器码数据流，从 rbx 保存的恢复参数还原两个不同的活动 Bar 帧，再用各自存活的创建记录，接回 launch_profile 和 launch_inventory。展示运行中，分配器为两次 Baz 分配返回了同一个地址。去掉 Bar 的恢复模型或创建历史后，两次观测均无法归属。
findings_zh.limits: 本实验在同一线程调度旧档案中 C++20 示例的两个实例。Linux x86-64 的 Clang 19.1.7 构建省略帧指针。采样由指令地址触发，使用从去掉应用符号与展开表的 ELF 进程采得的寄存器和栈字节。构建地址图时不使用额外的函数边界文件或已记录的恢复区间，之后再添加调试名称。两批实验共核对 32 条拼接，覆盖两种帧布局，并分别交换创建和调度顺序。

cases.contribution: Two extra frame allocations return the same child address. Instruction dataflow recovers the two distinct active parent frames and connects the allocation sites to their original application callers.
cases.contribution_zh: 两次额外分配返回相同的子协程帧地址。用机器码数据流恢复两个不同的活动父协程帧，就能把分配现场分别接回最初的应用调用者。

cases.title: Which caller's retries kept a ready task waiting?
cases.title_zh: 哪个调用者的重试让已就绪任务迟迟无法运行？

findings.observation: A ready heartbeat task waits while the first stream poll performs 102 retry attempts on the parent of the fix. With the fix, the heartbeat runs after 31 attempts. One of the fixed poll's 32 child polls parks a retry with an exhausted budget. Both builds eventually complete all 102 attempts. Within each revision, ordinary Rust backtraces show the same RetryBudget::poll and FuturesUnordered::poll_next path for both children, even when their retry budgets and submission order are exchanged.
findings.interpretation: The retry samples carry neither a child ID nor a caller label. Their thread and timestamp select the actual child poll interval. The node recorded in that interval then identifies the original push stack. In the displayed run, launch_profile accounts for 96 pre-heartbeat attempts and launch_inventory for six. Records 5–7 and 8–10 bracket the two displayed samples. Withholding the poll intervals leaves the retry stacks unassigned.
findings.limits: This Linux x86-64 replay uses two bounded, immediately requeued retry futures and a ready heartbeat on LocalPool. The probe marks child poll boundaries, and each captured stack is a checkpoint at a retry attempt. The counts measure work before the heartbeat in this fixture. Two independent builds and replays verify 1,064 sampled joins across both revisions, both submission orders, and both load assignments.

findings_zh.observation: 在修复提交的父版本中，首次轮询该流时做完 102 次重试，已就绪的心跳任务才得到运行机会。修复后，心跳在第 31 次重试后运行。修复版当轮进行了 32 次子 Future 轮询，其中有一次只是让耗尽配额的 Future 等待。两版最终都完成 102 次重试。同一版本中，普通 Rust 调用栈只显示相同的 RetryBudget::poll 和 FuturesUnordered::poll_next 路径。交换重试配额或提交顺序后，栈仍然一致。
findings_zh.interpretation: 重试采样时没有子 Future ID 或调用者标签。CoroPerf 用线程和时间戳找到实际的子节点轮询区间，再沿区间内记录的节点身份接回原始入队栈。展示运行中，心跳前的 96 次重试来自 launch_profile，另外 6 次来自 launch_inventory。两次展示采样分别落在记录 5–7 和 8–10 之间。去掉轮询区间后，采样失去归属。

cases.title: Which caller reacquired the semaphore ahead of its queued waiter?
cases.title_zh: 哪个调用者越过排队的任务，重新拿到了信号量？

findings.observation: On CPython 3.10.3, release marks the already-queued task's Future ready. The holder gets the next permit and the earlier waiter stays blocked. The earlier waiter gets the next permit on 3.10.4 and 3.14.3 in this replay. After dispatch, the Task stacks, creation tracebacks, and coroutine origins omit both original launchers. The 3.14.3 call graph shows the current wait sites.
findings.interpretation: CoroPerf records the actual Future woken by release and the Task that receives the next permit. The displayed grant stack joins the acquisition to its Task creation, then follows the matching dispatch Handle back to launch_profile. The waiting stack connects to launch_inventory through its own Handle. Withholding the Handle edges leaves both Task creation stacks at the shared dispatch site.
findings.limits: The two traces show a bounded two-task replay on Linux and CPython 3.10.3. Matched comparisons also ran on 3.10.4 and 3.14.3. The experiment uses one permit and lets both tasks drain through normal completion.

findings_zh.observation: CPython 3.10.3 在 release 时确实把已经排队的任务对应的 Future 设为就绪，但下一次许可仍由原持有者取得，先排队的任务继续等待。在本实验中，3.10.4 和 3.14.3 都把许可交给了先排队的任务。回调执行后，Task 栈、调试创建栈和协程起源都缺少两个原始发起者。3.14.3 的原生调用图能显示当前等待位置。
findings_zh.interpretation: CoroPerf 记录 release 实际唤醒的 Future，以及实际获得下一次许可的 Task。下方许可栈接回该 Task 的创建栈，再沿匹配的回调 Handle 找到 launch_profile。仍在等待的 Task 通过自己的 Handle 接回 launch_inventory。移除 Handle 边后，两条链都只能回到共享的 dispatch。
findings_zh.limits: 页面展示 Linux 上 CPython 3.10.3 的双任务受控实验，并在 3.10.4 和 3.14.3 运行相同对照。实验使用一个许可，最后让两个任务正常完成。

cases.contribution: The woken waiter and the next permit recipient are different Tasks on 3.10.3. The matching dispatch Handles restore the separate application callers.
cases.contribution_zh: 在 3.10.3 中，被唤醒的等待者和下一次实际获得许可的是不同 Task。用各自的调度 Handle 拼回创建栈，可以区分两个原始调用者。

cases.title: Which unsafeRun call started each failed ZIO fiber?
cases.title_zh: 两条失败的 ZIO fiber 分别从哪个 unsafeRun 发起？

findings.observation: Two caller threads launch the same effect, and both worker fibers fail with the same message. On Scalaz ZIO 1.0-RC5, the native trace and failure report differ only in Fiber ID. An all-thread Java stack snapshot shows both blocked unsafeRun calls but no link to a particular worker fiber. On the upstream fix, each native fiber trace includes its own unsafeRun source line.
findings.interpretation: CoroPerf matches the actual FiberContext receiver observed by JDI at construction to the receiver of captureTrace on the worker failure path. The two joins recover importOrders at Gateways.scala line 42 and refreshCatalog at line 45. Each pair is checked against the separately recorded runtime Fiber ID and worker thread.
findings.limits: The issue reports missing diagnostics. This case uses a controlled two-fiber replay on Scala 2.12.8 and JVM 8, with JDI observing the original 1.0-RC5 runtime. The Java stack snapshot is taken while both unsafeRun calls are active.

findings_zh.observation: 两个调用线程启动同一个 effect，随后两个工作线程上的 fiber 都报出相同的错误消息。在 Scalaz ZIO 1.0-RC5 上，原生追踪和失败报告只在 Fiber ID 上有区别。Java 全线程快照能看到两个正在等待的 unsafeRun，但无法把它们对应到各自的工作线程 fiber。应用上游修复后，原生追踪能显示每条 fiber 的 unsafeRun 调用行。
findings_zh.interpretation: CoroPerf 通过 JDI 对照创建时的 FiberContext 与工作线程上 captureTrace 使用的对象。用同一对象拼接后，分别找回 Gateways.scala 第 42 行的 importOrders 和第 45 行的 refreshCatalog。每组匹配都有独立记录的 Fiber ID 和工作线程作为核对。
findings_zh.limits: 上游问题针对诊断信息缺失。证据来自 Scala 2.12.8 和 JVM 8 上的双 fiber 受控实验，JDI 观测原始 1.0-RC5 运行时。Java 全线程快照记录在两个 unsafeRun 都还在等待时。

cases.contribution: The two worker failures have the same native trace. Matching each FiberContext receiver to its construction recovers the precise unsafeRun caller.
cases.contribution_zh: 两条 worker 失败的原生栈相同。根据实际 FiberContext 对象拼回创建栈，可以找回每次 unsafeRun 的确切调用者。

cases.title: Which caller occupied the worker needed by asyncio's resolver?
cases.title_zh: 哪个调用者占用了 asyncio 地址解析需要的线程？

findings.observation: In a gated two-worker experiment, the numeric lookup is submitted to the single-thread default pool. It stays pending when the private-pool worker is released and dispatches only after the default-pool worker exits its blocking work. The median construction-to-dispatch delay is about 125 ms with the shared pool and 0.18 ms when the blocking work moves to a dedicated pool. The two worker stacks and asyncio Task diagnostics omit the original callers.
findings.interpretation: The snapshot of the default-pool worker matches the WorkItem created at run_in_executor. That work holds the same request object that the shared broker dequeued from the application queue, so its enqueue stack identifies launch_profile in the displayed run (4 → 10 → 15). The second chain (5 → 11 → 16) identifies the concurrently busy private-pool worker. Swapping pool assignments swaps the caller responsible for the delay.
findings.limits: The two stacks are from a Linux replay on CPython 3.11.15, with additional controls on 3.14.3. The resolver uses a numeric loopback address and the workload sets the occupation interval. The measurements characterize executor queueing in this replay. Calls to an external DNS server are outside its scope.

findings_zh.observation: 在受控的双工作线程实验中，数字地址解析进入只有一个线程的默认池。私有池的工作先结束，查询仍在等待。默认池的工作结束后，查询才开始执行。在共享池中，从工作项构造到派发的中位延迟约为 125 毫秒。把阻塞工作移到独立池后约为 0.18 毫秒。两个工作线程的调用栈和 asyncio Task 诊断都缺少原始提交者。
findings_zh.interpretation: CoroPerf 将默认池线程的快照接回 run_in_executor 创建的同一 WorkItem。该工作项持有公共调度器从应用队列取出的同一个请求对象，沿入队栈可找回本次占用默认池的 launch_profile（4 → 10 → 15）。第二条链（5 → 11 → 16）对应同时繁忙的私有池线程。交换池分配后，造成等待的原始调用者也随之改变。
findings_zh.limits: 两条栈来自 Linux 上的 CPython 3.11.15 复现，另在 3.14.3 跑了对照。实验用数字回环地址，并控制线程占用时间，因此这些数值描述本地线程池排队。外部 DNS 服务器不在测量范围内。

cases.contribution: Matching the blocked worker to its exact executor WorkItem and the broker's earlier queue request identifies which application caller occupied the DNS worker.
cases.contribution_zh: 把被占用的工作线程接回实际 WorkItem，再沿调度器取出的同一个请求找到入队栈，可以辨认占用 DNS 工作线程的应用调用者。

cases.title: Which callers submitted the child futures stranded by task tracing?
cases.title_zh: 任务追踪卡住的两个子 Future 分别由谁提交？

findings.observation: On Tokio 1.53.1, tracing the mutex handoff leaves two child futures pending and the mutex locked after 50 further parent polls. Stock Trace::capture shows the semaphore and mutex acquire stacks during the tracing poll and no leaf stacks once the children stop being polled. The two initial stock stacks stay the same when the launchers swap roles or submission order.
findings.interpretation: Each leaf stack is sampled without a child ID. CoroPerf assigns the semaphore sample to the child poll bracketed by records 6 and 8, and the mutex sample to records 9 and 11. The actual FuturesUnordered node in each interval leads back to the creation stack, recovering launch_profile and launch_inventory in the displayed run. Withholding those intervals leaves both samples unassigned.
findings.limits: The displayed stacks are from a two-child extension of the official mutex handoff regression test on Linux x86-64. The scoped probe records FuturesUnordered node allocation and poll events. Stock and probed tests use Tokio 1.53.1 and 1.53.2. The merged change in 1.53.2 lets both children finish. The GitHub issue remains open.

findings_zh.observation: 在 Tokio 1.53.1 中，对互斥锁交接过程做追踪后，即使再轮询父任务 50 次，两个子 Future 仍未完成，互斥锁也一直处于锁定状态。原生 Trace::capture 在触发问题时能看到信号量和互斥锁的等待栈。两个子 Future 停止被轮询后，原生追踪没有返回叶子栈。交换发起顺序或角色后，最初的两条原生栈保持一致。
findings_zh.interpretation: 采样时没有子 Future ID。CoroPerf 用记录 6 到 8 的 poll 区间定位信号量采样，用记录 9 到 11 的区间定位互斥锁采样。再用区间内实际运行的 FuturesUnordered 子节点回查创建栈，在本页两条链中分别找回 launch_profile 和 launch_inventory。移除 poll 区间后，两条采样都失去归属。
findings_zh.limits: 本页展示 Linux x86-64 上对官方锁交接回归测试所做的双子 Future 扩展。定向探针记录 FuturesUnordered 实际子节点的分配与 poll。对照覆盖 Tokio 1.53.1 和 1.53.2。已合并并进入 1.53.2 的修复使两个子 Future 都能完成，GitHub Issue 仍开放。

cases.title: Which async interceptor led to the worker that lost the request ID?
cases.title_zh: 请求 ID 在线程池丢失时，是哪个异步拦截器路径发起的？

findings.observation: Two RPCs call the same method with the same payload. On the reported gRPC build, the request ID is present when each asyncio server Task submits its work, and both sync handlers read None on the worker threads. The proposed context-copy change restores the ID. On both builds, the inspected worker stacks and Task diagnostics omit both interceptor routes.
findings.interpretation: The active WorkItem connects the worker's read_request_id stack to its creation under run_in_executor. At submission, that WorkItem holds the exact handler created earlier by the same server Task inside route_profile or route_inventory. Both boundaries are recorded. Removing the handler-to-WorkItem edge keeps the worker-to-submission join and loses the earlier route.
findings.limits: The original report was reproduced separately. The stacks below use a controlled two-request replay on the reported gRPC Cython build and CPython 3.9.18, with a selected Task and WorkItem probe. The context-copy comparison uses the unmerged proposal.

findings_zh.observation: 两条 RPC 使用同一个方法和相同载荷。报告中的 gRPC 版本在 asyncio Task 提交时仍有请求 ID，两个同步处理器在线程池里读取时都得到 None。提议的上下文复制改动可恢复该值。在两种构建中，工作线程栈和所查的 Task 诊断都没有显示两个拦截器路径。
findings_zh.interpretation: CoroPerf 用实际执行的 WorkItem，把工作线程中的 read_request_id 接回 run_in_executor 下的创建栈。提交时，该 WorkItem 持有的处理器就是同一个服务端 Task 在 route_profile 或 route_inventory 中创建的对象。去掉处理器到 WorkItem 的边之后，仍能接回提交栈，但更早的拦截器路径消失。
findings_zh.limits: 原始报告已有独立复现。下方展示报告使用的 gRPC Cython 构建和 CPython 3.9.18 上的双请求受控实验，使用定向 Task 和 WorkItem 探针。上下文复制对照使用了未合并的提案。

cases.contribution: The two workers have identical stacks and both lose the request ID. Joining the active WorkItem to its submission and the exact per-RPC handler restores the original interceptor route.
cases.contribution_zh: 两个工作线程的栈完全相同，请求 ID 也都丢失。用实际 WorkItem 接回提交栈，再按同一个 RPC 处理器对象拼接，就能找回最初的拦截器路径。

cases.title: Who started the tasks that outlived a failed asyncio.gather()?
cases.title_zh: asyncio.gather() 失败后，仍在运行的任务是谁发起的？

findings.observation: On CPython 3.14.3, the stock call graph still lists the gather waiter after a sibling has failed and the waiter has moved on. The upstream patch removes that stale edge and retains a later direct waiter where one exists. Once the callback Handles are collected, the inspected Task stacks, debug creation tracebacks, coroutine origins, and built-in call graphs omit both original launchers.
findings.interpretation: CoroPerf connects each pending survivor snapshot to the creation of the same Task. The Handle that was running when dispatch created that Task connects its creation to the earlier call_soon stack, which identifies launch_profile or launch_inventory. The callback edge is necessary to distinguish the two creators in these captures.
findings.limits: The upstream issue concerns current await edges. Caller attribution is evaluated in a controlled two-launcher extension on Linux with a scoped callback probe. The two traces below use CPython 3.14.3 with the official backport applied to a private copy of asyncio/tasks.py.

findings_zh.observation: 在 CPython 3.14.3 中，gather 的一个子任务报错后，原生调用图仍把已经转去等待其他对象的 gather 调用者列为等待者。应用官方补丁后，这条过期边消失，后来直接等待该 Task 的调用者仍会显示。回调 Handle 被回收后，Task 栈、调试创建栈、协程起源和原生调用图都缺少两个原始发起者。
findings_zh.interpretation: CoroPerf 先把 survivor 快照接回同一个 Task 的创建栈。dispatch 创建 Task 时正在执行的 Handle，把这条创建记录连到更早的 call_soon 提交栈，从而找回 launch_profile 或 launch_inventory。移除回调这条边后，两条记录都无法再区分原始发起者。
findings_zh.limits: 上游问题针对当前等待关系。发起者归属是在 Linux 上用两个发起入口和定向回调探针验证的。下方两条链使用同一 CPython 3.14.3 解释器，官方回移补丁应用于单独复制的 asyncio/tasks.py。

cases.contribution: The fixed await graph shows who still waits. Matching each survivor Task to the Handle that dispatched its creation recovers who originally launched it.
cases.contribution_zh: 修复后的等待图能显示谁仍在等待。CoroPerf 把每个存活 Task 接回触发其创建的 Handle，找出最初是谁发起的。

cases.title: Main disappears from the physical stack after Foo resumes
cases.title_zh: Foo 恢复后，物理调用栈里找不到 Main

findings.observation: In the original .NET program, a stack captured inside A’s constructor after Foo resumed no longer showed Main.
findings.interpretation: Comparing the original and instrumented assemblies, the async state-machine identity linked A’s constructor diagnostic to the call in Main that created Foo.
findings.limits: The trace identifies the origin of this invocation only.

findings_zh.observation: 原始 .NET 程序在 Foo 恢复后从构造函数抓栈，物理栈已看不到 Main。
findings_zh.interpretation: 对照原程序与织入后的同一程序集，状态机标识把 A 构造函数中的诊断重新连到创建 Foo 的 Main。
findings_zh.limits: 只追踪这次调用；不是所有可能等待者的枚举。

cases.contribution: The constructor stack begins on a timer worker. Joining it to creation recovers Program.Main as the initiator of this Foo state machine.
cases.contribution_zh: 构造函数的物理栈起于计时器工作线程。拼回创建栈后，可以确定这次 Foo 状态机由 Program.Main 发起。

cases.title: Recovering the caller behind a synchronous Task forwarder
cases.title_zh: 找回同步转发 Task 的原始调用者

findings.observation: In the draft CoreCLR async-stack mode, a direct await displays Program.DirectOuter. Through the synchronous Task forwarders, both resumed stacks show Program.Callee as the only application method. TPL payloads carry task IDs and the same operation name. The stock dotnet-trace Speedscope view and task-aware TraceEvent worker stacks also omit both launchers.
findings.interpretation: CoroPerf captures the physical stack at TraceOperationBegin. The unlabeled worker sample is assigned to the active TPL Execution interval on its thread, then joined to the creation record for the same Task ID. In the displayed run Task 4 spans records 4–8 and joins observation 5 to LaunchInventory at creation 2. Task 1 spans records 9–13 and joins observation 10 to LaunchProfile at creation 0. All eight observations match independent Task IDs and post-await checkpoints across both launch orders.
findings.limits: A controlled two-caller extension of the upstream synchronous-forwarder example, on Linux x64 with draft CoreCLR commit 7e2cfb7b13b5. The runtime emits the TPL creation and execution events used here. The profile control uses dotnet-trace 10.0.750501 and TraceEvent 3.1.23, with a brief post-await sampling window.

findings_zh.observation: 草案 CoreCLR 的异步栈模式在直接 await 时显示 Program.DirectOuter。经过同步 Task 转发后，两条恢复栈的业务方法都只有 Program.Callee。TPL 事件携带 Task ID，但操作名相同。标准 dotnet-trace 的 Speedscope 视图和启用任务追踪的 TraceEvent 工作线程栈也都缺少两个发起者。
findings_zh.interpretation: CoroPerf 在 TraceOperationBegin 记录物理创建栈。用采样线程上活跃的 TPL Execution 区间确定该采样所属的 Task，再按同一个 Task ID 找到创建记录。页面里，Task 4 的执行区间为记录 4–8，将观测 5 连回记录 2 中的 LaunchInventory。Task 1 的区间为记录 9–13，将观测 10 连回记录 0 中的 LaunchProfile。两种发起顺序共 8 次观测，均通过独立记录的 Task ID 和 await 后检查点核对。
findings_zh.limits: 这是按上游同步转发示例扩展的双调用者实验，运行于 Linux x64 和 CoreCLR 草案提交 7e2cfb7b13b5。采集依赖这版运行时的 TPL 创建和执行事件。采样分析对照使用 dotnet-trace 10.0.750501 和 TraceEvent 3.1.23，并在 await 后留出短暂采样窗口。

cases.contribution: The same callee runs for two synchronous forwarders. TPL execution intervals and recorded task creation stacks connect each worker observation to its original caller.
cases.contribution_zh: 两个同步转发方法调用同一个协程。CoroPerf 用 TPL 执行区间和已记录的任务创建栈，把每个工作线程观测分别连回原始调用者。

cases.title: Synchronous SQL on Drogon’s database loop times out the profile request
cases.title_zh: Drogon 在数据库事件循环上执行同步 SQL，导致请求超时

findings.observation: A PostgreSQL-backed HTTP request timed out when the profile path ran synchronous SQL on Drogon’s database event loop.
findings.interpretation: The blocked stack and the shared coroutine’s creation record pointed to profile_entry, and moving execution to a different loop allowed the request to finish.
findings.limits: The Drogon 1.9.9 app recreated the reported mechanism. The original ORM project was unavailable.

findings_zh.observation: 实际 PostgreSQL 请求在 Drogon 数据库循环上同步执行 SQL，profile 路径超时。
findings_zh.interpretation: 阻塞栈和共享协程的创建记录把等待指向 profile_entry；切回其他循环的对照正常。
findings_zh.limits: Drogon 1.9.9 的 HTTP/SQL 应用按上游机制改写，未部署原 ORM 项目。

cases.contribution: Two request entries use shared_lookup. The stopped sample's owner and the recorded creator chain identify profile_entry as the origin of the blocked request.
cases.contribution_zh: 两个请求入口都使用 shared_lookup。将停止现场归到具体协程后，沿创建关系可以确认卡住的是由 profile_entry 发起的请求。

cases.title: Which caller launched the coroutine that reported the stale thread ID?
cases.title_zh: 报出旧线程 ID 的协程由哪个调用者发起？

findings.observation: With Clang 6.0.0 at -O2, two instances of the same coroutine resume on one worker and print the same stale pthread ID. The reference call and the Linux TID place both resumes on the worker. Symbolized GDB displays the same functions and PCs for both resumes and omits both launchers. The same-thread and -O0 controls report the current ID.
findings.interpretation: In this build, the creation code stores the first pthread_self result at frame offset 0x18, and the resume code reloads it for the diagnostic. CoroPerf uses instruction dataflow on the stripped binary to recover each resume's frame argument from registers and stack bytes. It joins that live frame to its recorded creation stack. Record 2 → 3 identifies launch_inventory, and 1 → 4 identifies launch_profile. Removing either the resume model or creation history leaves both observations unattributed.
findings.limits: A controlled two-caller extension of the archived Linux x86-64 Coroutines TS reproduction. The app uses frame-pointer omission, and its optimized ELF has application symbols and CFI removed. Numeric test anchors select where to capture. Debug symbols label PCs after the address-based graph is built. Two fresh batches each verify eight joins against the actual resumed handles.

findings_zh.observation: 在 Clang 6.0.0 的 -O2 构建中，同一协程的两个实例在同一工作线程恢复，并打印出相同的旧 pthread ID。对照调用和 Linux TID 都显示恢复发生在工作线程。带完整符号的 GDB 为两次恢复显示相同的函数与指令地址，而且缺少两个发起者。同线程和 -O0 对照都报告当前线程 ID。
findings_zh.interpretation: 该构建的创建代码把首次 pthread_self 的结果写到协程帧偏移 0x18，恢复代码从该位置取回旧值并传给日志。CoroPerf 根据去符号后机器码的数据流，从寄存器和栈字节还原各次恢复的帧地址，再接回对应的创建栈。记录 2 → 3 恢复 launch_inventory，1 → 4 恢复 launch_profile。去掉恢复函数的机器码模型或创建历史，两条观测均无法归属。
findings_zh.limits: 这是对旧档案中 Linux x86-64 Coroutines TS 复现的双调用者扩展。应用以省略帧指针的选项编译，并从优化后的 ELF 中去掉应用符号与栈展开表。数字地址指定采集点，基于地址的图构建完才加载调试符号显示函数名。两批各 8 条拼接都与实际恢复的句柄一致。

cases.contribution: The same worker stack and stale thread ID describe two instances. The stripped machine code identifies the frame at each resume, and its recorded creation stack restores the launcher.
cases.contribution_zh: 同一个工作线程的调用栈和旧线程 ID 对应两个不同的协程实例。CoroPerf 用去符号的机器码定位各自恢复的帧，再拼回创建栈找出原始调用者。

cases.title: A spawned task remains in the local LIFO slot when its worker blocks
cases.title_zh: Tokio 的 LIFO 槽位保留了一个没有及时轮询的任务

findings.observation: In the eager-dispatch workload, another worker did not steal the task from the LIFO slot, and the task timed out after its spawning worker blocked.
findings.interpretation: Scheduler records linked schedule_local, slot placement, the blocked worker and the child’s first poll, with normal scheduling and a disabled LIFO slot as controls.
findings.limits: The bounded replay used Tokio source probes. It covered the scheduler mechanism rather than the full production workload.

findings_zh.observation: 急切派发工作负载中，工作线程阻塞后，新任务在 LIFO 槽中未被其他线程窃取并发生超时。
findings_zh.interpretation: 调度记录把 schedule_local、LIFO 槽、原工作线程的阻塞和子任务的首次轮询相连；禁用 LIFO 与正常调度分别作对照。
findings_zh.limits: 有界 Tokio 执行器实验使用源码观测点；不是完整的生产工作负载。

cases.title: Which callers incurred the extra interval timer clears?
cases.title_zh: 额外的 interval 定时器清理由哪些调用者触发？

findings.observation: With 2,048 tasks on 10 ms intervals, median process CPU time increased by 22–25% from Tokio 1.52.4 to 1.53.1 in two local batches. The upstream fix reduced CPU time by 16–22% against its parent. In the separate probe, the two launchers shared one stock spawn location and all 384 timer-clear observations in each pre-fix run had the same physical function stack.
findings.interpretation: CoroPerf uses the active task poll interval on the sampled worker to select the task creation stack. In the displayed run, intervals 158–166 and 160–238 establish joins 34 → 159 for launch_profile and 76 → 161 for launch_inventory. All 768 observations across both launch orders agree with independently recorded Task IDs and returned JoinHandles. Both fixed-revision runs record zero timer clears inside a tick poll.
findings.limits: Controlled Linux x86-64 adaptation with four workers and parking_lot. Stock builds supply the CPU comparison. The separate two-caller capture uses 32 interval tasks and a probe in the driver's clear_entry on the fix and its parent. These counts cover tick polls. Final timer teardown occurs outside that scope.

findings_zh.observation: 在 2,048 个任务分别使用 10 ms interval 的负载下，两批本地实验中，Tokio 1.53.1 的进程 CPU 时间中位数比 1.52.4 高 22–25%。上游修复比它的父提交低 16–22%。在单独的探针实验中，两个发起入口的原生 spawn 位置相同，修复前每轮的 384 次定时器清理也只有一种物理函数栈。
findings_zh.interpretation: CoroPerf 用工作线程上的活跃 poll 区间确定采样属于哪个 Task，再拼回其创建栈。区间 158–166 支撑从记录 34 到 159 的拼接，恢复 launch_profile。区间 160–238 支撑从记录 76 到 161 的拼接，恢复 launch_inventory。两种启动顺序下的 768 次观测都与独立记录的 Task ID 和返回的 JoinHandle 一致。两轮修复版对照在 tick poll 内都记录到 0 次清理。
findings_zh.limits: 这是 Linux x86-64 上的受控改编，使用四个工作线程和 parking_lot。CPU 比较来自未加探针的版本。单独的双调用者实验用 32 个 interval，在修复及其父提交的 clear_entry 中加探针，统计每次 tick poll 内的清理。最后销毁定时器发生在统计区间外。
